headline: No scored news; a calm midweek
body: A quiet day with no scored events. Earlier announcements kept fading, shifting a few endings by a hundredth of a point. Horizon Balance is -4.91. After Monday's drone and hacking news, Self-Destruction holds third place at 25.92, behind Enslaved God and Conquerors.
movers_note: No ending moved by a tenth of a point; only fading earlier events, at 0.01 each.
